recipes.note: Face-only recipes v2 for the PlayerBase candidates (supersedes v1). Coefficient-space blend of MH_PlayerBase's conformed face with 3 of Epic's built-in presets (/MetaHumanCharacter/Optional/Presets) per candidate: out = ours + sum w_i*(preset_i - ours) per face-model region ('blend' = every region not listed in 'regions'; groups in Scripts/MetaHuman/pb_face_build.py REGION_GROUPS), then eyelid landmark moves via translate_face_landmarks (UE cm; 36,20,35 / 52,44,51 upper lids, 19,37 / 33,53 lower lids, 18 / 22 outer eye corners). Body state untouched. Validated in scratch as explore round 3 (A3_lm, B3_lm2, C3_lm).

MH_PlayerBase_FaceA.concept: rounder, fuller-cheeked young face; softer jaw; short rounded nose; fuller lips (Bo + Kelvin, Tuya eyes)

MH_PlayerBase_FaceB.concept: broad cheekbones, squarer chin and jaw, straighter open eyes, shorter nose (Aoi + Orlando, Tuya eyes/nose)

MH_PlayerBase_FaceC.concept: broad nose, full wide mouth, strong wide lower face, larger open eyes (Kelvin + Jorge, Aera eyes)
